audit_result.proof_trace: Missing Fulu deprecation check. After FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS, BlobRPCMinValidSlot still calculates minStart = currEpoch - minReqEpochs, allowing recent blobs to be served indefinitely. Should reject all requests or return far-future slot once deprecation deadline passes.
audit_result.attack_scenario: After current epoch >= FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS, peer sends BlobSidecarsByRangeRequest for recent slots. Handler serves blobs instead of responding empty, violating protocol deprecation requirement and preventing migration to data columns.

PROP-6a4369e9-inv-028.text: blob_sidecars_by_range must be fully deprecated after FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS.

audit_result.proof_trace: The quota check exits immediately when quota reaches zero, breaking out of the sidecar loop mid-block. This violates atomicity: if Block B has sidecars [1,2,3] and quota=2, only sidecars 1 and 2 are sent, leaving sidecar 3 unsent despite sidecar 1 being included in the response.
audit_result.attack_scenario: Attacker requests a large range forcing quota exhaustion mid-block. Peer receives partial sidecars for the final block, causing reconstruction failure or wasted bandwidth as the incomplete set is below the PeerDAS threshold required for data availability.

PROP-6a4369e9-inv-043.text: All sidecars of a block must be included in by_range response if any sidecar is included.
PROP-6a4369e9-inv-043.assertion: forall block, resp: any_sidecar_included(block, resp) => all_sidecars_included(block, resp)

audit_result.proof_trace: Config loader performs YAML unmarshaling into BlobSchedule with no validation that MaxBlobsPerBlock entries are <= 4096. This allows misconfigured nodes to accept BlobSchedule values above the SSZ hard limit (MAX_BLOB_COMMITMENTS_PER_BLOCK=4096), creating a protocol-network inconsistency where blocks with >4096 commitments are protocol-valid per verifyBlobCommitmentCount but cannot be SSZ-encoded/decoded for P2P transmission.
audit_result.attack_scenario: An attacker distributes a malicious config file with BLOB_SCHEDULE: [{EPOCH: 0, MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK: 5000}]. Nodes loading this config will accept blocks with up to 5000 KZG commitments in verifyBlobCommitmentCount (payload.go:239), but such blocks cannot be transmitted over P2P due to SSZ's 4096 hard limit (conversions_block.go:1367, fieldparams/mainnet.go:29). This causes honest validators to propose valid-but-untransmittable blocks, leading to chain stalls or consensus divergence between nodes using different validation code paths.

PROP-56ad1eb2-inv-014.text: All BLOB_SCHEDULE max_blobs_per_block values must be <= MAX_BLOB_COMMITMENTS_PER_BLOCK.
PROP-56ad1eb2-inv-014.assertion: forall entry in BLOB_SCHEDULE: entry.max_blobs_per_block <= MAX_BLOB_COMMITMENTS_PER_BLOCK

audit_result.proof_trace: Locally-produced data columns bypass anti-equivocation cache. The broadcastAndReceiveDataColumns path saves columns via ReceiveDataColumns but never calls setSeenDataColumnIndex, while the gossip subscriber path (receiveDataColumnSidecar:L42) does update the cache. This violates the invariant that all imported columns must be tracked.
audit_result.attack_scenario: Validator produces and broadcasts data columns which are saved to storage but not marked in the anti-equivocation cache, creating cache inconsistency that could allow duplicate column acceptance if re-submitted through different paths or enable equivocation detection bypass.

PROP-6a4369e9-inv-013.text: Anti-equivocation cache must be updated for all imported data columns regardless of publishing.

audit_result.proof_trace: The streamBlobBatch function serves all blobs in the requested range without checking if blob epoch < FULU_FORK_EPOCH. MaxBlobsForEpoch() is used only for iteration count, not filtering. No epoch-based guard exists in blobSidecarsByRangeRPCHandler or validateBlobsByRange to enforce the transition boundary.
audit_result.attack_scenario: During transition near FULU_FORK_EPOCH, a peer requests blob_sidecars_by_range with a range spanning the fork boundary. The handler serves blobs from both pre-Fulu and post-Fulu epochs without filtering, violating the protocol requirement that only pre-Fulu blobs should be served via this RPC after the fork.

PROP-6a4369e9-inv-029.text: During transition, blob_sidecars_by_range must serve only pre-Fulu epoch blobs.
PROP-6a4369e9-inv-029.assertion: forall sidecar in transition_resp: compute_epoch(sidecar.slot) < FULU_FORK_EPOCH
